comparison.duplicates: forbidden: every expected configuration appears exactly once
comparison.numericTolerance: exact match; all values are integers or strings
comparison.note: Python sorts parameter names alphabetically with 'model' last (traigent/optimizers/grid.py); JS ordering is not documented as equivalent, so only set equality and count are asserted.
comparison.adapterRequirement: Adapters must check the raw output count and detect duplicates in the raw output; deduplicated cardinality alone is not sufficient.

derivation: Grid search is defined as exhaustive enumeration of the cartesian product of each parameter's discrete value list. Sizes are 2 (model) x 2 (strategy) x 3 (top_k) = 12, so exactly 12 distinct configurations are expected, each assigning one value to every parameter. maxTrials (100) exceeds 12 so no truncation applies. The listing above was written by hand from this definition and was not produced by running either SDK.
